cards.name: Step
cards.text: Move up to 2 spaces. Each point may move 1 space in either direction or turn in place.

cards.name: Quick Step
cards.text: Move 1 space or turn in place.

cards.name: Dash
cards.text: Move up to 3 spaces, spending movement freely on spaces and/or turning.

cards.name: Pivot
cards.text: Turn around, then you may Move 1.

cards.name: Quick Strike
cards.text: Attack for 2 damage at Range 1.

cards.name: Heavy Strike
cards.text: Attack for 4 damage at Range 1 and ignore 1 Block.

cards.name: Lunge
cards.text: Move up to 2, then Attack for 2 damage at Range 1.

cards.name: Shove
cards.text: Attack for 1 damage at Range 1. You may Push 2 on hit.

cards.name: Guard
cards.text: Gain Block 2 this reveal.

cards.name: Brace
cards.text: Gain Block 3 until end of round. You cannot be pushed or pulled this round.

cards.name: Dodge Roll
cards.text: Move 1, then gain Dodge until end of round.

cards.name: Counter Stance
cards.text: Gain Block 2 this reveal. If this reduces an adjacent opponent Attack to 0 damage, deal 1 direct damage back after that Attack resolves.

cards.name: Recover
cards.text: Heal 1 HP, then you may Move 1.

cards.name: Feint
cards.text: Move 1 or turn in place. Your Action 2 gets +2 Speed this round.

cards.name: Battle Cry
cards.text: Gain 1 additional Coin when this Basic resolves (2 Coins total including the normal Basic Coin).

cards.name: Sweep
cards.text: Attack for 2 damage at Range 1. You may Push 1 on hit.

cards.name: Retreating Jab
cards.text: Attack for 1 damage at Range 1. After resolving, Move up to 1.

cards.name: Focus
cards.text: Look at the top 2 cards of your deck; keep one on top and put the other on bottom.

cards.name: Shoulder Charge
cards.text: Move up to 2. If you finish at Range 1, Attack for 2. If the Attack hits, Push 1; you may follow by the distance actually pushed.

cards.name: Hammer Drop
cards.text: Attack for 5 damage at Range 1.

cards.name: Groundbreaker
cards.text: Attack for 3 damage. On hit, Push 1.

cards.name: Blood Price
cards.text: Lose 2 HP, then gain 2 Fury. This self-damage cannot be Blocked.

cards.name: Reckless Swing
cards.text: Lose 1 HP, then Attack for 5 damage at Range 1.

cards.name: Backbreaker
cards.text: Attack for 3 damage. If the opponent is on an active battlefield edge, deal +2 damage and ignore 2 Block.

cards.name: Plant Your Feet
cards.text: Gain Block 3 until end of round. If you do not move again before your next Attack this round, that Attack gets +1 damage.

cards.name: Overrun
cards.text: Move up to 3 and you may cross the opponent. If you cross them, Push them 1 in the direction you travelled.

cards.name: Unstoppable Charge
cards.text: Move up to 3 spaces. If you reach Range 1, Attack for 2 damage and Push 1 on hit.
cards.timing: Unlock once at 3 Fury. Added to hand; after use, joins normal discard/deck cycle.

cards.name: Vanish
cards.text: Move 1, then Set Dodge.

cards.name: Shadow Step
cards.text: Move up to 2 and may cross the opponent. If you cross them, Set Dodge.

cards.name: Backstab
cards.text: Attack for 3 damage at Range 1 and ignore 1 Block. If Raven is Behind immediately before auto-turn, deal +2 damage.

cards.name: Throwing Knives
cards.text: Attack for 3 damage at Range 2-3.

cards.name: Feinting Slash
cards.text: Attack for 2 damage. If it causes HP loss, Set Dodge.

cards.name: Pickpocket
cards.text: Attack for 2 damage at Range 1. On hit, steal 1 Coin if possible.

cards.name: Smoke Veil
cards.text: Gain Block 2 this reveal. After both Action Packages in this reveal finish, Move 1. If this card prevented any damage, Set Dodge.

cards.name: Poisoned Blade
cards.text: Attack for 2 damage at Range 1 and ignore 2 Block.

cards.name: Shadowstep
cards.text: Move up to 2 spaces and may cross the opponent. Set Dodge.
cards.timing: Unlock once at 3 Fury. Added to hand; after use, joins normal discard/deck cycle.

cards.name: Quick Shot
cards.text: Attack for 2 damage at Range 2-4.

cards.name: Pinning Arrow
cards.text: Attack for 2 damage. On hit, reduce the opponent’s next Movement this round by 1, minimum 0.

cards.name: Power Shot
cards.text: Attack for 4 damage at Range 3-4.

cards.name: Reposition
cards.text: Move up to 2. If you finish at Range 3 or farther, gain Aim.

cards.name: Point Blank
cards.text: Attack for 2 damage at Range 1. Push 2 on hit.

cards.name: Volley
cards.text: Attack for 2 damage and ignore 1 Block.

cards.name: Peek
cards.text: Privately inspect the opponent’s unrevealed Action 2, or 1 random hand card if none remains. Gain Aim, then you may Move 1.

cards.name: Marked Target
cards.text: Mark the opponent. Your next ranged Attack that hits this round deals +2 damage.

cards.name: Eagle Eye
cards.text: Gain Aim. If the opponent still has an unrevealed programmed Action, privately look at it; otherwise look at 2 random cards from their hand. Then you may Move 1.
cards.timing: Unlock once at 3 Fury. Added to hand; after use, joins normal discard/deck cycle.

cards.name: One-Two
cards.text: Attack twice for 1 damage each. Card-wide damage bonuses apply to the first Attack only. The opponent gains at most 1 Fury from this card.

cards.name: Flowing Step
cards.text: Move up to 2. If you finish at Range 1, your next Attack this round deals +1 damage.

cards.name: Coin Toss
cards.text: Attack for 2 damage. Before damage, you may spend 1 Coin to deal +2 damage.

cards.name: Low Sweep
cards.text: Attack for 2 damage. This Attack cannot be Dodged. On hit, reduce the opponent’s next Movement this round by 1, minimum 0.

cards.name: Threefold Strike
cards.text: Attack up to 3 times for 1 damage each. Stop after the first Attack that causes no HP loss. Card-wide damage bonuses apply to the first Attack only.

cards.name: Meditate
cards.text: Gain Block 2 until end of round. Your next Attack this round ignores 2 Block.

cards.name: Empty Hand
cards.text: Attack for 2 damage. Deal +2 damage if Franc currently holds no Loot.

cards.name: Perfect Sequence
cards.text: Attack for 4 damage. If your Action 1 card caused HP loss this round, make a second Attack for 2 damage. Card-wide bonuses apply to the first Attack only.

cards.name: Flurry of Faith
cards.text: Attack twice for 1 damage each at Range 1. If both cause HP loss, draw 1 at cleanup before refilling. Card-wide bonuses apply to the first Attack only.
cards.timing: Unlock once at 3 Fury. Added to hand; after use, joins normal discard/deck cycle.

cards.name: Shield Up
cards.text: Gain Block 4 this reveal.

cards.name: Advance Behind Shield
cards.text: Move 1, then gain Block 2 this reveal.

cards.name: Shield Bash
cards.text: Attack for 3 damage. Deal +1 damage if Helga currently has Resolve. If Helga has Block active, Push 1 on hit.

cards.name: Hold the Line
cards.text: Gain Block 3 until end of round. Helga cannot be pushed or pulled this round.

cards.name: Reversal
cards.text: Gain Block 2 this reveal. If this reduces an adjacent opponent Attack to 0 damage, deal 2 direct damage back after that Attack resolves.

cards.name: Body Check
cards.text: Move 1, then Attack for 2 damage. Push 2 on hit; you may follow by the distance actually pushed.

cards.name: Guard Break
cards.text: Attack for 3 damage and ignore 2 Block.

cards.name: Wallop
cards.text: Attack for 3 damage. Push 1 on hit.

cards.name: Shield Wall
cards.text: Gain 5 Block until end of round.
cards.timing: Unlock once at 3 Fury. Added to hand; after use, joins normal discard/deck cycle.

cards.name: Bandage Up
cards.text: Heal 1 HP.

cards.name: Sedative Dart
cards.text: Attack for 2 damage. On hit, the opponent’s next programmed Action this round gets -2 Speed.

cards.name: Sterile Field
cards.text: Gain Block 3 this reveal.

cards.name: Scalpel
cards.text: Attack for 1 damage and ignore all Block.

cards.name: Adrenaline
cards.text: Move 1. If played as Action 1, Shealer’s Action 2 gets +2 Speed and may Move 1 before resolving.

cards.name: Painkiller
cards.text: Gain Block 2 this reveal. If this prevents at least 2 damage, Heal 1 after that Attack resolves.

cards.name: Defibrillator
cards.text: Attack for 4 damage. Deal +2 damage if Shealer has 8 HP or less when it resolves.

cards.name: Diagnosis
cards.text: If Action 1: privately look at opponent’s Action 2, then Move 1. If Action 2: draw 1 card, then discard 1 card.

cards.name: Emergency Treatment
cards.text: Heal 1 HP. Gain exactly 1 Remedy total from this card, including your passive.
cards.timing: Unlock once at 3 Fury. Added to hand; after use, joins normal discard/deck cycle.

cards.name: Alarm Clock
cards.text: This Action Package gets +3 Speed. The attached Action card’s first Attack ignores 1 Block.

cards.name: Attack Kitten
cards.text: After your Action card resolves, make a Loot Attack for 3 damage at Range 1-2.

cards.name: Blowgun
cards.text: After your Action card resolves, make a Loot Attack for 3 damage at Range 3-4 and ignore 1 Block.

cards.name: Cleats
cards.text: Before your Action, you may Move up to 2. If this movement crosses the opponent, the attached Action card’s first Attack gets +1 damage.

cards.name: Dueling Pickles
cards.text: The first Range 1 Attack made by the attached Action card gets +2 damage.
cards.timing: When the attached Range 1 Attack deals damage

cards.name: Explosive Barrel
cards.text: After your Action, the opponent loses 3 HP and you lose 1 HP simultaneously. Then both Heroes move 1 away from the battlefield center if able. This HP loss ignores Block and Dodge.

cards.name: Gum & String
cards.text: Return 1 Loot from the Loot discard pile to your Loot hand, then discard Gum & String.

cards.name: Coin Finder
cards.text: Gain 3 Coins, then draw 1 Loot. If you hold more than 2 Loot, discard down to 2.

cards.name: Stunner Glasses
cards.text: Reduce the next Attack damage you would take by 2. After that Attack resolves, its attacker loses 1 HP if any damage was reduced. Expires when your next Action Package starts.

cards.name: Super Glue
cards.text: The attached Action card’s first Attack gains +2 Push on hit. Prevent the next Push or Pull before your next Action Package; if prevented, your next Attack this round gets +1 damage.

cards.name: Smoke Bomb
cards.text: Gain a separate pool of 4 Block lasting until the start of your next Action Package. After your Action card resolves, you may Move 1.
cards.timing: Before your Action card resolves; movement after Action

cards.name: Fury Flask
cards.text: Gain 1 Fury after your Action. Gain 1 additional Fury if your HP is then lower than the opponent’s. Fury remains capped at 5.

cards.name: Teleport Scroll
cards.text: Move to any legal unoccupied active battlefield space before resolving the attached Action. Teleporting does not change facing.

cards.name: Wand of Orcus
cards.text: The attached Action card’s first Attack ignores all Block and cannot be Dodged. It must still be in Range.
cards.timing: When the first Attack from your Action card resolves

cards.name: Holy Hand Grenade
cards.text: After your Action card resolves, make a Loot Attack for 4 damage at Range 2-4.

cards.name: Homing Pigeons
cards.text: Before Action 1, privately inspect the opponent’s Action 2 and give your Action 2 +2 Speed. After your Action 1 resolves, you may Move up to 2.

cards.name: Grappling Hook
cards.text: Before the first Attack of the attached Action checks Range, Pull the opponent up to 2 spaces. Then check Range.
cards.timing: Before the attached Attack checks Range

cards.name: Protein Shake
cards.text: Attach only to an Attack card. Its first Attack gets +3 damage, but this Action Package’s effective Speed becomes 1.

cards.name: Crystal Ball
cards.text: After Action 1, privately inspect the opponent’s Action 2. You may replace your own Action 2 with a card from your hand. Your next Attack this round ignores 2 Block.

cards.name: Binoculars
cards.text: Increase the first Attack’s maximum Range by 2 for this resolution. Minimum Range is unchanged.
cards.timing: Before the attached Attack checks Range

cards.name: Jackhammer
cards.text: The first Range 1 Attack made by the attached Action card gets +1 damage and +2 Push on hit.
cards.timing: When the attached Range 1 Attack deals damage

cards.name: Pinwheel
cards.text: Before your Action, you may Move up to 2. Until your next Action Package, reverse up to 2 spaces of the next Push or Pull that would move you.

cards.name: Charcuterie Board
cards.text: Heal 1 before your Action. The attached Action card’s first Attack gets +2 damage.

cards.name: Lucky Charm
cards.text: Attach to a Basic. This package gets +2 Speed. After it resolves, return that Basic to your hand instead of discarding it at cleanup.

heroes.name: Lord Smasherton
heroes.traitText: Pain Is Power: each effect causing HP loss gives 1 Pain, up to 2 gained per round. Your next Attack consumes all Pain for that much bonus damage, even if it misses. Self-damage grants no Fury unless printed.

ultimate.name: Closing Walls
ultimate.text: Remove the leftmost and rightmost active battlefield spaces. Heroes occupying a removed space relocate to the nearest legal active space.

heroes.name: Raven Madison
heroes.traitText: Hold 1 Dodge. Spend it to cancel one Attack and all its on-hit effects. After that Attack, you may Move 1; your next Attack this round gets +1 damage and ignores 1 additional Block. Unused Dodge expires at cleanup. Backstab rewards attacking from Behind.

ultimate.name: Living Shadow
ultimate.text: For the rest of combat, once per round after you move through or end a movement Behind the opponent, Set Dodge and your next Backstab this round gets +1 damage.

heroes.name: Alf Featherbottom
heroes.traitText: Aim - Alf may hold 1 Aim. At the end of a reveal, if Alf did not move or get moved, gain Aim. Before one of his Attacks resolves, spend Aim to increase maximum Range by 1, or deal +2 damage if the opponent is currently at Range 3 or farther.

ultimate.name: No Safe Distance
ultimate.text: For the rest of combat, your ranged Attacks ignore maximum Range (minimum Range still applies). Your first ranged Attack each round also ignores 2 Block.

heroes.name: Friar Franc
heroes.archetype: Combo fighter / Fury engine / resource pressure
heroes.traitText: Discipline: resolve a Basic as Action 1 to give a Hero card (including your unlocked Skill) in Action 2 +1 Speed and +1 damage on its first Attack only. If both Action cards cause HP loss, gain 1 Fury after Action 2, once per round. Loot damage does not qualify.

ultimate.name: Divine Rhythm
ultimate.text: For the rest of combat, your first hit each round primes your next Action card this round: +1 Speed and +1 damage to its first Attack. It must be a later Action card, not a later hit of the same card. One step per round; Loot cannot trigger or consume it.

heroes.name: Helga Stonewall
heroes.traitText: Resolve: hold 1. Once per round, after your Block prevents at least 2 total Attack damage (including across multiple Attacks), gain Resolve. Before an Attack deals damage, spend Resolve for +2 damage and +1 Push.

ultimate.name: ABSOLUTELY NOT
ultimate.text: Immediately gain 2 Block until end of round. For the rest of combat, at cleanup you may carry up to 2 unused Block into the next round. It remains a finite pool and does not stack with Lasting Guard.

heroes.name: Dr. Shealer
heroes.traitText: Remedies - after one of Shealer’s Hero cards or Hero Skill with printed Block/Healing resolves, gain 1 Remedy, max once per card. Before one of her cards resolves, spend at most 1 Remedy to Move 1 before resolving, add +1 Block if it has Block, or add +2 damage if it is an Attack.

ultimate.name: Miracle Worker
ultimate.text: Immediately Heal 2 HP and gain 1 Remedy. For the rest of combat, the first time each round a Hero Action card (including your Skill) actually heals you, gain 1 additional Remedy (max 3). Basic cards and Loot do not trigger this bonus.

arenaFury.text: At the end of round 13, both Heroes lose 2 HP simultaneously. Increase this loss by 2 each later round. Arena Fury ignores Block and Dodge, grants no Fury or Pain, and a double knockout is a draw.
